utility.notes: Danville is a well-documented Contra Costa County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: MCE (Marin Clean Energy)
value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms Danville as one of 16 Contra Costa County communities it serves (alongside Concord, El Cerrito, Hercules, Lafayette, Martinez, Moraga, Oakley, Pinole, Pittsburg, Pleasant Hill, Richmond, San Pablo, San Ramon, Walnut Creek, and unincorporated Contra Costa County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Danville/Contra Costa County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value: Request an inspection by calling (925) 314-3333 or via the online Citizen Self Service (CSS) portal at danville.ca.gov/CSS
Request before 3:00 p.m. for next-business-day inspection; inspections can be scheduled up to 5 days in advance
The following day's 2-hour inspection time windows are posted online after 5:00 p.m.
inspection_steps.notes: This is the Town's general Building Division inspection scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the Town's page does not describe a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Standard small residential rooftop solar energy system permitting
other_conditions: Systems must meet applicable health and safety standards imposed by the state, the Town of Danville, and the San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District
